Image generation requesting multiple images

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"model\":\"dall-e-2\",\"n\":3,\"prompt\":\"A red bicycle\",\"size\":\"256x256\"}", CreateImageRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.imageGenerate(req)
    println(result.data)
    println(result.data.first().url)
}
```
